mainEntity.name: How does the tool count words?

acceptedAnswer.text: It counts groups of characters separated by spaces or line breaks, ignoring stray symbols. Hyphenated words such as "well-known" count as one word, and numbers count as words.

mainEntity.name: What is a good Flesch Reading Ease score?

acceptedAnswer.text: For general audiences, 60 to 70 is plain English that most adults find easy. Web content and marketing often aim for 60 or higher, while technical and academic writing can score much lower.

mainEntity.name: How is reading time worked out?

acceptedAnswer.text: Word count divided by reading speed. The default is 238 words per minute, the average for adult silent reading of non-fiction, and speaking time uses 150 words per minute.

mainEntity.name: Is my text sent to a server?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Everything runs in your browser and nothing is uploaded or saved. The share link contains only your settings, not your text.
Each formula weighs sentence length, syllables or letters differently, and syllable counting is an estimate. Treat the scores as a guide and look at the range, not a single number.
